scope: Sixth-order descriptive recomputation from the unchanged public EdgeBench 51-task per-time README table. The continuation and risk-set treatments are proposed Frontier-Science experiments and gates, not EdgeBench causal results.
source_facts: The paper defines S(t) as best-so-far performance and states that the with-experience curve averages three 12-hour best-so-far curves per task before averaging across tasks.
The public README exposes displayed 2h, 4h, 6h, 8h, 10h and 12h values for 51 tasks and five models, yielding 255 task-model sequences.
The public release does not include the raw 38000-hour trajectory corpus or figure-analysis code, so displayed-table inconsistencies cannot be causally attributed from public evidence alone.

descriptive_recomputation.source: official GitHub README public 51-task per-time table
descriptive_recomputation.continuation_sensitivity_policy: For this sensitivity only, require all six displayed checkpoints, replace each sequence by its cumulative maximum, and retain cells with positive 2h-to-12h total gain.

late_four_hour_gain_exceeds_early_four_h.definition: displayed cumulative-maximum gain from 8h to 12h is greater than gain from 2h to 6h

delayed_takeoff_sequences.definition: displayed cumulative-maximum gain from 2h to 6h is at most 1.0 point and gain from 6h to 12h is at least 2.0 points

descriptive_recomputation.recomputation_note: Cumulative-maximum repair is used only to make the delayed-takeoff sensitivity conservative under the declared best-so-far estimand. It is not a permitted repair for Frontier-Science source trajectories, which must instead pass event-level replay.

frontier_science_protocol_changes.design: Under a fixed total task-hour budget compare fixed-12h, deterministic 2h-headroom, randomized-positive-probability and uncertainty-aware futility policies; force a random audit tranche to 12h independent of its early outcome.

Freeze scheduled run IDs, replay selector events, require every single-run observer envelope to be monotone, publish checkpoint run-flow counts, and separate failure-inclusive ITT, fixed paired-completer and explicitly dynamic-risk-set summaries.

claim_boundary: The six displayed decreases are public-table observations, not proof that EdgeBench raw single-run best-so-far trajectories decrease or that its reported aggregate result is wrong.
The delayed-takeoff counts are descriptive thresholded sensitivities on rounded displayed means, not causal estimates of the value of continuation.
The 13.4 percent public-table fraction must not be transferred as an expected Frontier-Science late-bloomer rate.
Until CA1 is run, a 2h headroom gate may allocate exploratory engineering resources but cannot support an unbiased full-cohort 12h estimate.
Until M2 passes, no long-horizon Frontier-Science aggregate should be labeled a fixed-cohort best-so-far trajectory.
